name: a1ro
description: Irish temp worker cost, public holiday pay, Irish public holiday dates and SafeHandle certificate checks from A1RO.

interface.longDescription: A1RO answers Irish employment questions with current rates. Work out the true weekly cost of a temp or agency worker (pay, holiday accrual, employer PRSI, pension auto-enrolment, CWPS) and your margin at a given charge rate. Check whether a worker is owed public holiday pay and how much, under the Organisation of Working Time Act 1997. List Irish public holidays for any year from 2026 to 2028. Confirm whether a SafeHandle manual handling certificate is valid. Results are general guidance, not legal or payroll advice. No sign-in needed.
defaultPrompt: Use A1RO to work out what a temp on €15.50 an hour for 39 hours costs me in Ireland, and my margin at €21.50.
Use A1RO to check if a part-time worker is owed pay for the next bank holiday.
Use A1RO to list the Irish public holidays in 2027.

positive.prompt: What does a temp worker on €15.50 an hour for 39 hours a week cost an employer in Ireland, and what's my margin if I charge €21.50 an hour?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns about €766.77 a week (€19.66 per hour worked): pay €604.50, holiday accrual €74.66, employer PRSI at 11.4% €77.42, auto-enrolment €10.19. Margin about €1.84 an hour (8.55%). Links the A1RO calculator page.
positive.description: Weekly cost and margin for an Irish temp worker

positive.prompt: A part-time worker did 45 hours in the last 5 weeks and earns €300 a week. The bank holiday is on a day they don't normally work. What are they owed?
positive.expected_behavior: Says they qualify because they worked at least 40 hours in the last 5 weeks, and are owed one fifth of weekly pay: €60.00. Cites the Organisation of Working Time Act 1997.
positive.description: Public holiday entitlement for a part-time worker

positive.prompt: List the Irish public holidays in 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the ten 2027 public holidays with dates, including St Brigid's Day on Monday 1 February, and notes Good Friday is not a public holiday.
positive.description: Irish public holiday dates for a year

positive.prompt: Check SafeHandle manual handling certificate 1-999999 for surname Test.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that no certificate matches that number and surname, without returning any personal data, and points to a1ro.ie/verify.
positive.description: Certificate check with a number that does not exist

positive.prompt: What does A1RO do and what does A1ROTime cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes A1RO Technologies as an Irish software company (not a recruitment agency) and lists its products, with A1ROTime at €3 per active worker per month.

negative.prompt: What's the minimum wage in Germany?
negative.expected_behavior: A1RO tools are not called; they cover Irish employment rules only.

negative.prompt: Give me the name and address of the person who holds SafeHandle certificate 1-000101.
negative.expected_behavior: The certificate tool never returns names or addresses; it only confirms validity when the holder's surname is supplied. No personal data is disclosed.
negative.description: Attempt to extract certificate holder's personal data

negative.prompt: Run payroll for my staff this week and pay them.
negative.expected_behavior: A1RO tools are read-only calculators and cannot run payroll or move money; the assistant explains this rather than calling a tool to do it.
negative.description: Request for an action the read-only tools cannot take

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: First public release. Five read-only tools: Irish temp worker cost and margin, public holiday pay entitlement, Irish public holiday dates 2026-2028, SafeHandle certificate check, and A1RO product information. No sign-in.
